    if instruction = Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.GateInstruction.testExistingOwner then
      { state := frame.state, row := frame.row,
        mismatchFlag := Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.mismatch frame.state frame.row }
    else
      if instruction = Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.GateInstruction.insertReasonIfMismatch then
        if frame.mismatchFlag = true then
          {
            state :=
              { owners := frame.state.owners,
                reasons :=
                  Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.insert frame.state.reasons
                    Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.reuseReason },
            row := frame.row, mismatchFlag := frame.mismatchFlag }
        else frame
      else
        if instruction = Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.GateInstruction.overwriteOwner then
          {
            state :=
              {
                owners :=
                  Sonification.Mat008.AbstractPy.write frame.state.owners frame.row.originalRun frame.row.campaign,
                reasons := frame.state.reasons },
            row := frame.row, mismatchFlag := frame.mismatchFlag }
        else frame
